PLAN "Deload Week: Post-Hypertrophy"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "deload and recovery"

PHASES
  PHASE "Deload Week" (1 week):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body Push":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          tricep_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday training 45m "Lower Body":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 2x30s rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          superman 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
          cat_cow 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Upper Body Pull":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
          bicep_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower Body & Core":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 2x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          lunge 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 2x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
      DAY Saturday training 40m "Optional Cardio/Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 20m rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 2m
          spinal_twist 2m
      DAY Sunday training 0m "Rest":
        warmup:
        main straight_sets:
        cooldown:

PLAN "Hypertrophy Block: Week 4 Volume Calculation"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "calculate previous week volume"

PHASES
  PHASE "Hypertrophy Week 4" (1 week):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 75m "Upper Body Push":
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x10 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
        # Total sets: 4+4+3+3 = 14 (example, but you said 18 working sets/session)
      DAY Tuesday training 75m "Lower Body":
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x10 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 4x10 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
        # Total sets: 4+4+4+3+3 = 18
      DAY Wednesday training 75m "Upper Body Pull":
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x8 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x10 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x10 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
        # Total sets: 4+4+4+3+3 = 18
      DAY Thursday training 75m "Lower Body":
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x8 rpe 8.5 rest 120 seconds
          lunge 4x10 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 4x10 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
        # Total sets: 4+4+4+3+3 = 18
      DAY Friday training 75m "Full Body/Accessory":
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x10 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          squat 3x10 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x8 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x10 rpe 8.5 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x60s rpe 8.5 rest 60 seconds
        # Total sets: 3+3+3+3+3 = 15 (if you want 18, add more accessory sets)
      # Typical session: 18 working sets

# Last week's volume per session (sets):
# Monday: 18
# Tuesday: 18
# Wednesday: 18
# Thursday: 18
# Friday: 18

# Deload target (commonly 40-60% of normal volume):
# 40% of 18 = 7.2 (round to 7)
# 50% of 18 = 9
# 60% of 18 = 11

# For a deload, target 7–9 working sets per session.
